name: Paraluni
fix_description: Add nonReentrant guard to deposit/addLiquidityInternal flow. When depositing tokens with transfer hooks (e.g. fee-on-transfer or callback tokens), the attacker can re-enter during the token transfer before liquidity accounting is finalized.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a multi-step price manipulation using a flash loan, Pancake V3 swaps, and repeated interaction with a protocol-specific vulnerable swap contract. While the PoC is short and straightforward once understood, an auditor would still need to analyze the target contract’s pricing/authorization logic and how the approved address parameter can be abused under manipulated market conditions.
